Body Encoding\n330\t\n331\tRequest/response bodies are base64-encoded to handle binary data and ensure JSON compatibility.\n332\t\n333\t## Integration Approach Recommendations\n334\t\n335\t### Phase 1: Pre-Migration (Current)\n336\t\n337\t**Goal:** Build comprehensive corpus before implementing SEAM routes\n338\t\n339\t**Actions:**\n340\t1. The corpus capture system enables differential testing by recording HTTP request/response pairs from the incumbent ArgoCD proxy before migrating services to SEAM.\n\n## Current Architecture Overview\n\n### 1. SEAM Server Structure\n\nThe SEAM gateway (`internal/server/server.go`) currently implements:\n\n- **Dual-listener architecture:**\n  - Caller-facing port (default 8080) - for external clients\n  - Operator-only port (default 8081) - for administrative operations\n\n- **Control-plane endpoints** (reserved paths that short-circuit route-table lookup):\n  - `/openapi.json` - OpenAPI spec serving\n  - `/docs` - API documentation\n  - `/_seam/healthz` - Kubernetes liveness probe\n  - `/_seam/readyz` - Kubernetes readiness probe\n  - `/_seam/metrics` - Prometheus metrics\n  - `/config/status` - Configuration fragment status\n\n- **Route-fragment system (planned):** Dynamic route loading from OpenAPI fragments\n\n### 2. Incumbent ArgoCD Proxy\n\nThe current ArgoCD read-only proxy is accessed via:\n- **Endpoint:** `https://argocd-ro-ardenone-manager-ts.ardenone.com:8444`\n- **Authentication:** Injected bearer token (read-only)\n- **Access:** Tailscale VPN entrypoint only\n\n**Key API Routes Used:**\n\n1. **Applications**\n   - `GET /api/v1/applications` - List all applications\n   - `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}` - Get specific application\n   - `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}/sync` - Get sync status\n   - `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}/manifest` - Get application manifest\n\n2. **Clusters**\n   - `GET /api/v1/clusters` - List all clusters\n   - `GET /api/v1/clusters/{name}` - Get specific cluster details\n\n3. **Repositories**\n   - `GET /api/v1/repositories` - List repositories\n   - `GET /api/v1/repositories/{url}` - Get specific repository\n\n## Corpus Capture Mechanism\n\n### Architecture\n\n```\n┌─────────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐\n│  Test/Agent     │────▶│ seam-capture │────▶│ Incumbent Proxy │\n│  (curl, etc.)   │     │  (localhost) │     │  (argocd-ro)     │\n└─────────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └──────────────────┘\n         │                      │                       │\n         │                      ▼                       │\n         │                ┌─────────────┐              │\n         │                │ Corpus File │              │\n         │                │ (JSON)      │              │\n         │                └─────────────┘              │\n         ▼                                              ▼\n    Response                                     Response\n```\n\n### Components\n\n#### 1. seam-capture Binary\n\n**Location:** `./seam-capture` (built from `tools/diffharness/cmd/seam-capture/main.go`)\n\n**Key Features:**\n- Transparent reverse proxy using `httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy`\n- Captures all HTTP request/response pairs\n- Records to corpus JSON file with unique entry IDs\n- Periodic auto-save (every 10 entries) to prevent data loss\n- Graceful shutdown with corpus save\n\n**Capture Flow:**\n\n```go\n1. Append entry to corpus\n6. Return response to client\n```\n\n#### 2. Corpus Format\n\n**Schema Version:** `seam-diff-corpus/v1`\n\n**Location:** `corpus/argocd-proxy/corpus.json`\n\n**Structure:**\n```json\n{\n  \"schema\": \"seam-diff-corpus/v1\",\n  \"service\": \"argocd\",\n  \"incumbent\": \"https://argocd-ro-ardenone-manager-ts.ardenone.com:8444\",\n  \"capturedAt\": \"2026-07-27T12:00:00Z\",\n  \"description\": \"ArgoCD read-only proxy corpus\",\n  \"entries\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"api-v1-applications-get\",\n      \"description\": \"GET /api/v1/applications\",\n      \"request\": {\n        \"method\": \"GET\",\n        \"path\": \"/api/v1/applications\",\n        \"query\": \"\",\n        \"headers\": {\"Accept\": [\"application/json\"]},\n        \"bodyB64\": \"\"\n      },\n      \"secrets\": [\n        {\n          \"ref\": \"vault:seam/routes/argocd/ro-token\",\n          \"injectAs\": {\"kind\": \"bearer\"}\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n**Security Model:**\n- Credentials stored as **references only** (e.g., `vault:seam/routes/argocd/ro-token`)\n- Never literal values in corpus files\n- Git-tracked corpus files are safe to commit\n- Literal values resolved at replay-time from local secrets source\n\n#### 3. Control Scripts\n\n**Location:** `scripts/capture-argocd.sh`\n\n**Operations:**\n- `start` - Launch capture proxy on port 8082\n- `stop` - Gracefully stop and save corpus\n- `status` - Show capture `https://argocd-ro-ardenone-manager-ts.ardenone.com:8444`\n- Listen port: 8082\n- Corpus path: `corpus/argocd-proxy/corpus.json`\n\n## Request/Response Flow Analysis\n\n### Current Incumbent Flow (Before SEAM)\n\n```\nClient → ArgoCD-RO Proxy → ArgoCD API Server → Response\n                │\n                └─ Injects bearer token\n```\n\n### Capture Phase Flow\n\n```\nClient → seam-capture → ArgoCD-RO Proxy → ArgoCD API Server → Response\n         │                    │\n         └─ Record to corpus └─ Injects bearer token\n```\n\n### Future SEAM Flow (After Migration)\n\n```\nClient → SEAM Gateway → Route Fragment → ArgoCD API Server → Response\n                  │\n                  └─ Inject secrets from Vault\n```\n\n### Differential Replay Flow\n\n```\nseam-replay → Incumbent Proxy → Response (recorded as baseline)\n      │\n      └─→ SEAM Gateway → Response (compared to baseline)\n```\n\n## Integration Points for Capture Middleware\n\n### Option 1: Standalone Capture Proxy (Current Implementation)\n\n**Implementation:** External process on separate port\n\n**Pros:**\n- Non-intrusive to SEAM server code\n- Easy enable/disable\n- Can run independently of SEAM\n- Safe for production use\n\n**Cons:**\n- Separate process to manage\n- Port conflict potential\n- Not integrated into SEAM's lifecycle\n\n**Architecture:**\n```\n:8080 (SEAM)     :8082 (seam-capture)     :8444 (argocd-ro)\n   │                    │                        │\n   └─ Control plane ───┴────────────────────────▶\n```\n\n### Option 2: SEAM Internal Middleware (Future Enhancement)\n\n**Implementation:** Middleware within SEAM's HTTP handlers\n\n**Integration Point:** In `setupRoutes()` or as middleware wrapper\n\n**Code Location:** `internal/server/server.go:99-109`\n\n**Example Integration:**\n```go\n// In setupRoutes()\ncaptureMiddleware := NewCaptureMiddleware(corpusPath)\ns.callerMux.Handle(\"/\", Intercept request before routing\n// 2. Record request details\n// 3. Pass through to route handler\n// 4. Capture response\n// 5. Append to corpus\n```\n\n**Pros:**\n- Integrated into SEAM lifecycle\n- Single process\n- Can capture SEAM's own responses\n- No port management\n\n**Cons:**\n- More complex implementation\n- Requires changes to core server\n- Potential performance impact on production\n\n## Data Flow Through Proxy\n\n### Stage 1: Request Capture\n\n```\nIncoming Request\n    ↓\nExtract components:\n  - Method (GET, POST, etc.)\n  - Path (/api/v1/applications)\n  - Query string\n  - Headers (canonicalized)\n  - Body (base64-encoded)\n    ↓\nCreate Request struct\n    ↓\n```\n\n### Stage 2: Forwarding\n\n```\nRequest struct\n    ↓\nhttputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(target)\n    ↓\nForward to incumbent\n    ↓\nResponse received\n```\n\n### Stage 3: Response Recording\n\n```\nResponse\n    ↓\nExtract components:\n  - Status code\n  - Headers\n  - Body\n    ↓\nCreate Entry struct\n    ↓\nAppend to corpus.Entries\n    ↓\nPeriodic save (every 10 entries)\n```\n\n## Key Design Decisions\n\n### 1. Corpus Entry ID Generation\n\n**Current:** `entryID(r)` generates ID from method + path\n```go\npath := strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, \"/\")\nreturn strings.ToLower(strings.ReplaceAll(path, \"/\", \"-\")) + \"-\" + strings.ToLower(r.Method)\n```\n\n**Result:** `/api/v1/applications` + `GET` → `api-v1-applications-get`\n\n### 2. Secret Reference Format\n\n**Pattern:** `vault:<path-to-secret>`\n\n**Example:** `vault:seam/routes/argocd/ro-token`\n\n**Injection Kind:** `bearer` for ArgoCD\n\n### 3. Header Canonicalization\n\nAll header keys are canonicalized using `http.CanonicalHeaderKey` to ensure case-insensitive comparison.\n\n### 4. Body Encoding\n\nRequest/response bodies are base64-encoded to handle binary data and ensure JSON compatibility.\n\n## Integration Approach Recommendations\n\n### Phase 1: Pre-Migration (Current)\n\n**Goal:** Build comprehensive corpus before implementing SEAM routes\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Populate secret references\n\n**Status:** ⏳ Pending\n\n### Phase 3: SEAM Implementation\n\n**Goal:** Implement SEAM route fragment for argocd-ro\n\n**Actions:**\n1. Run `seam-replay` against both incumbents\n2. Compare responses\n3. Fix any discrepancies\n4. Ensure all corpus entries pass\n\n**Status:** ⏳ Pending\n\n## Security Considerations\n\n### Corpus File Security\n\n- ✅ Corpus files contain **only secret references**, not values\n- ✅ Safe to commit to git\n- ✅ Can be shared without credential exposure\n- ✅ Review process ensures no accidental credential leakage\n\n### Capture Proxy Security\n\n- ⚠️ Currently runs on localhost only\n- ⚠️ No authentication required (assumes trusted network)\n- ✅ No credential storage in capture proxy\n- ✅ Credentials injected at replay-time only\n\n## Performance Considerations\n\n### Capture Overhead\n\n- **Latency:** Single-hop proxy adds ~1-2ms per request\n- **Memory:** In-memory corpus until periodic save\n- **Disk:** JSON corpus grows linearly with captured entries\n- **Network:** No additional network calls beyond forwarding\n\n### Replay Performance\n\n- **Concurrent execution:** seam-replay hits both incumbents in parallel\n- **Comparison time:** Linear with response size\n- **Corpus size:** Thousands of entries supported\n\n## Troubleshooting Guide\n\n### Common Issues\n\n1. **Capture proxy won't start**\n   - Endpoints\n236\t\n237\t**Applications:**\n238\t1. `GET /api/v1/applications` - List all applications\n239\t2. `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}` - Get specific application\n240\t3. `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}/sync` - Get sync status\n241\t4. `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}/manifest` - Get application manifest\n242\t\n243\t**Clusters:**\n244\t1. `GET /api/v1/clusters` - List all The corpus serves as the oracle for differential testing during service migration to SEAM.\n\n## Design Principles\n\n1. **Security-First:** Credentials stored as references only, never literal values\n2. **Git-Tracked:** Corpus files are committed to version control for reproducibility\n3. **Replayable:** Each entry can be replayed verbatim against both incumbent and SEAM\n4. **Differential-Ready:** Structured for comparison between two HTTP responses\n5. **Self-Documenting:** Human-readable descriptions and stable IDs\n\n## JSON Schema Definition\n\n### Top-Level Schema\n\n```json\n{\n  \"schema\": \"seam-diff-corpus/v1\",\n  \"service\": \"argocd\",\n  \"incumbent\": \"https://argocd-ro-ardenone-manager-ts.ardenone.com:8444\",\n  \"capturedAt\": \"2026-07-27T12:00:00Z\",\n  \"description\": \"ArgoCD read-only proxy corpus captured from production\",\n  \"entries\": []\n}\n```\n\n### Field Definitions\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `schema` | string | Yes | Schema version identifier. Must be `\"seam-diff-corpus/v1\"` |\n| `service` | string | Yes | Service name token. Must be `\"argocd\"` |\n| `incumbent` | string | Yes | Base URL of incumbent proxy captured against |\n| `capturedAt` | string | Yes | RFC3339 timestamp of first capture |\n| `description` | string | Yes | Free-form description of the corpus |\n| `entries` | array | Yes | Array of corpus entry objects |\n\n### Entry Schema\n\n```json\n{\n  \"id\": \"list-applications-get\",\n  \"description\": \"List all ArgoCD applications\",\n  \"request\": {\n    \"method\": \"GET\",\n    \"path\": \"/api/v1/applications\",\n    \"query\": \"\",\n    \"headers\": {\n      \"Accept\": [\"application/json\"]\n    },\n    \"bodyB64\": \"\",\n    \"bodyContentType\": \"\"\n  },\n  \"secrets\": [\n    {\n      \"ref\": \"vault:seam/routes/argocd/ro-token\",\n      \"injectAs\": {\n        \"kind\": \"bearer\"\n      }\n    }\n  ],\n  \"expect\": {\n    \"ignoreHeaders\": [\"Date\", \"Server\"]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### Entry Field Definitions\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `id` | string | Yes | Stable, human-readable entry ID (kebab-case) |\n| `description` | string | No | What this entry exercises |\n| `request` | object | Yes | HTTP request object (see below) |\n| `secrets` | array | No | Secret reference objects |\n| `expect` | object | No | Per-entry comparison overrides |\n\n### Request Object Schema\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `method` | string | Yes | HTTP method (canonicalized: GET, POST, etc.) |\n| `path` | string | Yes | Request path only, no query string |\n| `query` | string | No | Query string without leading `?` |\n| `headers` | object | No | Header map with canonicalized keys |\n| `bodyB64` | string | No | Base64-encoded request body |\n| `bodyContentType` | string | No | Content-Type of request body |\n\n### Secret Reference Schema\n\n```json\n{\n  \"ref\": \"vault:seam/routes/argocd/ro-token\",\n  \"injectAs\": {\n    \"kind\": \"bearer\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `ref` | string | Yes | Secret reference path (e.g., `vault:...`) |\n| `injectAs` | object | Yes | Injection specification (see below) |\n\n### InjectAs Schema\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `kind` | string | Yes | Injection method: `header`, `bearer`, or `query` |\n| `name` | string | Conditional | Header/query name (required for `header`/`query`, rejected for `bearer`) |\n\n### Expect Schema\n\n```json\n{\n  \"status\": 200,\n  \"ignoreHeaders\": [\"Date\", \"Server\", \"X-Request-Id\"],\n  \"ignoreBody\": false,\n  \"skip\": \"\"\n}\n```\n\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `status` | int | No | Expected status code (nil means differential comparison) |\n| `ignoreHeaders` | array | No | Header names to ignore during comparison |\n| `ignoreBody` | bool | No | Skip body comparison entirely |\n| `skip` | string | No | Skip reason (empty = not skipped) |\n\n## File Organization Structure\n\n### Directory Layout\n\n```\ncorpus/\n├── README.md                           # Corpus capture documentation\n├── capture-config.yaml                 # Global capture configuration\n└── argocd-proxy/\n    ├── README.md                       # ArgoCD-specific documentation\n    ├── corpus.json                     # Primary corpus file\n    ├── corpus-template.json            # Template with example entries\n    ├── applications-list.json          # Per-endpoint capture files (optional)\n    ├── clusters-list.json              # Per-endpoint capture files (optional)\n    └── metadata/\n        ├── capture-session.json        # Session metadata\n        └── validation-report.json      # Validation results\n```\n\n### File Naming Conventions\n\n**Primary corpus file:** `corpus.json`\n- Single source of truth for differential testing\n- Sorted by entry ID for stable diffs\n- Git-tracked\n\n**Per-endpoint captures:** `{endpoint}-{method}.json`\n- Optional granular capture files\n- Useful for debugging specific endpoints\n- Merged into primary corpus before testing\n\n**Template file:** `corpus-template.json`\n- Example entries showing all fields\n- Reference for manual corpus creation\n- Not used in automated testing\n\n## Metadata Format\n\n### Timestamps\n\n**Format:** RFC3339 with timezone offset\n\n**Locations:**\n1. **Corpus-level:** `capturedAt` field\n   - Set on first capture\n   - Never updated on subsequent appends\n   - Example: `\"2026-07-27T12:00:00-04:00\"`\n\n2. **Entry-level:** (optional) `capturedAt` in entry metadata\n   - Capture time of individual entry\n   - Useful for chronological analysis\n   - Not required for replay\n\n### Request IDs\n\n**Entry ID generation:**\n\n```\nentryID(path, method) = kebab-case(path) + \"-\" + lower(method)\n```\n\n**Examples:**\n- `/api/v1/applications` + `GET` → `api-v1-applications-get`\n- `/api/v1/clusters/{name}` + `GET` → `api-v1-clusters-name-get`\n- `/api/v1/applications/{name}/sync` + `GET` → `api-v1-applications-name-sync-get`\n\n**Manual IDs:** For special cases, IDs can be manually specified:\n- `health-check-get`\n- `metrics-get`\n- `streaming-logs-post`\n\n### Session Metadata\n\n**File:** `corpus/argocd-proxy/metadata/capture-session.json`\n\n```json\n{\n  \"sessionId\": \"capture-2026-07-27-120000\",\n  \"startedAt\": \"2026-07-27T12:00:00-04:00\",\n  \"endedAt\": \"2026-07-27T12:15:30-04:00\",\n  \"captureTool\": \"seam-capture\",\n  \"captureToolVersion\": \"v0.1.0\",\n  \"incumbentUrl\": \"https://argocd-ro-ardenone-manager-ts.ardenone.com:8444\",\n  \"entriesCaptured\": 15,\n  \"captureDurationSeconds\": 930,\n  \"captureHost\": \"localhost\",\n  \"capturePort\": 8082\n}\n```\n\n## ArgoCD-Specific Considerations\n\n### Key API Endpoints\n\n**Applications:**\n1. `GET /api/v1/applications` - List all applications\n2. `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}` - Get specific application\n3. `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}/sync` - Get sync status\n4. `GET /api/v1/applications/{name}/manifest` - Get application manifest\n\n**Clusters:**\n1. `GET /api/v1/clusters` - List all clusters\n2. `GET /api/v1/clusters/{name}` - Get specific cluster details\n\n**Repositories:**\n1. `GET /api/v1/repositories` - List repositories\n2. `GET /api/v1/repositories/{url}` - Get specific Definitions\n\nLocated in `tools/diffharness/internal/corpus/corpus.go`:\n\n```go\ntype Corpus struct {\n    Schema      string\n    Service     string\n    Incumbent   string\n    CapturedAt  string\n    Description string\n    Entries     []Entry\n}\n\ntype Entry struct {\n    ID          string\n    Description string\n    Request     Request\n    Secrets     []Secret\n    Expect      *Expect\n}\n\ntype Request struct {\n    Method          string\n    Path            string\n    Query           string\n    Headers         map[string][]string\n    BodyB64         string\n    BodyContentType string\n}\n\ntype Secret struct {\n    Ref      string\n    InjectAs InjectAs\n    Bare     string // never serialized\n}\n\ntype InjectAs struct {\n    Kind string\n    Name string\n}\n\ntype Expect struct {\n    Status        *int\n    IgnoreHeaders []string\n    IgnoreBody    bool\n    Skip          string\n}\n```\n\n## Validation Rules\n\n### Corpus-Level Validation\n\n1. **Schema version:** Must match `seam-diff-corpus/v1`\n2. **Service name:** Must be non-empty\n3. **Entry IDs:** Must be unique within corpus\n4. **Entry sorting:** Sorted by ID for stable diffs\n\n### Entry-Level Validation\n\n1. **ID:** Required, unique, stable\n2. **Request:** Required, with at least method and path\n3. **Headers:** Canonicalized keys Differential Testing Validation\n\n1. **Status comparison:** By default, require incumbent.status == seam.status\n2. **Header comparison:** Case-insensitive, ignoring specified headers\n3. **Body     true,\n\t\t\"/openapi.json\":       true,\n\t\t\"/whoami\":             true,\n\t\t\"/scopes\":             true,\n\t\t\"/changes\":            true,\n\t\t\"/health/credentials\": true,\n\t\t\"/health/upstreams\":   true,\n\t\t\"/config/status\":      true,\n\t},\n\tprefixes: []string{\n\t\t\"/docs/\",\n\t\t\"/health/\",\n\t\t\"/config/\",\n\t\t\"/approvals/\",\n\t\t\"/_seam/\",\n\t},\n}\n\n// isReservedPath checks if a given path is in the reserved control-plane set.\nfunc isReservedPath(path string) bool {\n\t// Check exact matches first\n\tif reservedPaths.exact[path] {\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\t// Check prefix matches\n\tfor _, prefix := range reservedPaths.prefixes {\n\t\tif len(path) >= len(prefix) && path[:len(prefix)] == prefix {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Config holds the server configuration\ntype Config \"\" {\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\t\tw.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)\n\t\tjson.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"error\": s.specLoader.GetAPIVersion())\n\tw.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)\n\tjson.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response)\n}\n\n// contains checks if a string contains a substring (case-insensitive)\nfunc contains(s, substr string) bool {\n\treturn len(s) >= len(substr) && (s == substr || len(s) > len(substr) && (s[:len(substr)] == substr || s[len(s)-len(substr):] == substr || indexOf(s, substr) >= 0))\n}\n\n// indexOf finds the index of a substring\nfunc indexOf(s, substr string) int {\n\tfor i := 0; i <= len(s)-len(substr); i++ {\n\t\tif s[i:i+len(substr)] == substr {\n\t\t\treturn i\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn -1\n}\n\n// Start begins listening on both ports\nfunc (s *Server) Start(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tcallerAddr := fmt.Sprintf(\":%d\", s.config.CallerPort)\n\toperatorAddr := fmt.Sprintf(\":%d\", s.config.OperatorPort)\n\n\tlog.Printf(\"Starting caller-facing listener on %s\", callerAddr)\n\tlog.Printf(\"Starting operator-only listener on %s\", operatorAddr)\n\n\t// Create listeners\n\tcallerListener, err := net.Listen(\"tcp\", callerAddr)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to bind caller port %d: %w\", s.config.CallerPort, err)\n\t}\n\n\toperatorListener, err := net.Listen(\"tcp\", operatorAddr)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tcallerListener.Close()\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to bind operator port %d: %w\", s.config.OperatorPort, err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Store listeners for shutdown\n\ts.callerListener = callerListener\n\ts.operatorListener = operatorListener\n\n\t// Wrap caller mux with validation middleware (always active for caller port)\n\tcallerHandler := s.validationMiddleware(s.callerMux)\n\tlog.Printf(\"Validation middleware active on caller-facing port\")\n\n\t// Wrap with capture middleware if enabled\n\tif s.captureMiddleware != nil {\n\t\tcallerHandler = s.captureMiddleware.Wrap(callerHandler)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"Capture middleware active on caller-facing port\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Create servers\n\ts.callerServer = &http.Server{\n\t\tHandler: callerHandler,\n\t}\n\ts.operatorServer = &http.Server{\n\t\tHandler: s.operatorMux,\n\t}\n\n\t// Start caller-facing
